scheduledTasks.name: NY-Sigon主程序
scheduledTasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
  const TASK_NAME = 'NY-Sigon主程序';
  const ctx = window.SillyTavern?.getContext?.();
  const ex = ctx?.extensionSettings?.LittleWhiteBox || {};
  ex.apiByTask ||= {};
  const ref = window.XBTasks?.find?.(TASK_NAME, 'all');
  const t = ref?.task || {};
  const ns = (t?.x?.LittleWhiteBox) || {};
  const apiNs = ns.api || {};
  const apiExt = ex.apiByTask[TASK_NAME] || {};
  const provider = String(apiNs.provider || apiExt.provider || 'st').toLowerCase();
  const url = String(apiNs.url || apiExt.url || '');
  const key = String(apiExt.key || '');
  const mdl = String(apiNs.model || apiExt.model || '');
  const enableNet = typeof apiNs.enableNet==='boolean' ? apiNs.enableNet : !!apiExt.enableNet;
  const SESSION_ID = 2;
  let useStream = typeof apiNs.stream==='boolean' ? apiNs.stream : (apiExt.stream ?? true);
  const streamSvc = window.xiaobaixStreamingGeneration;
  const streamSupported = !!streamSvc?.getStatus || !!streamSvc?.getLastGeneration;
  if (useStream && !streamSupported) useStream = false;
  const gen = (ns.gen && typeof ns.gen === 'object') ? ns.gen : {};
  const DEFAULT_REGEX_COMBINED = '/\\[([^\\s\\[\\]\\/]+)(?:\\s[^\\[\\]]*?)?\\]([\\s\\S]*?)\\[\\/\\1\\]/g';
  const parseCombinedRegex = (input) => {
    let raw = String(input || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return { pattern: '', flags: 'g' };
    if (raw.startsWith('/')) {
      const lastSlash = raw.lastIndexOf('/');
      if (lastSlash > 0) {
        const pattern = raw.slice(1, lastSlash);
        let flags = raw.slice(lastSlash + 1).replace(/[^gimsuy]/g, '');
        if (!flags.includes('g')) flags += 'g';
        return { pattern, flags };
      }
    }
    const lastBackslash = raw.lastIndexOf('\\');
    if (lastBackslash > -1 && lastBackslash < raw.length - 1) {
      const pattern = raw.slice(0, lastBackslash);
      let flags = raw.slice(lastBackslash + 1).replace(/[^gimsuy]/g, '');
      if (!flags.includes('g')) flags += 'g';
      return { pattern, flags };
    }
    return { pattern: raw, flags: 'g' };
  };
  let combined = ns.extractRegex || DEFAULT_REGEX_COMBINED;
  let { pattern: tagPattern, flags: tagFlags } = parseCombinedRegex(combined);
  let tagRe;
  try { tagRe = new RegExp(tagPattern, tagFlags); } catch { const p = parseCombinedRegex(DEFAULT_REGEX_COMBINED); tagRe = new RegExp(p.pattern, p.flags); }
  const ro = (r) => (r === 'system' ? 'sys' : r);
  const buildTopFromTpl = (tpl) => {
    if (!tpl || typeof tpl !== 'object') return '';
    const list = Array.isArray(tpl.scaffold) ? tpl.scaffold : [];
    const hasS = Number.isInteger(tpl.specialIndex);
    const total = list.length + (hasS ? 1 : 0);
    const segs = [];
    for (let i = 0, ri = 0; i < total; i++) {
      if (hasS && i === tpl.specialIndex) {
        const wi = tpl.includeWorldInfo ? '{$worldInfo}' : '';
        const depth = Number.isFinite(+tpl.historyDepth) ? +tpl.historyDepth : NaN;
        const theHist = Number.isFinite(depth) ? `{$history${depth}}` : '';
        const role = tpl.specialRoleType || 'system';
        const content = `${wi}${theHist}`;
        segs.push(`${ro(role)}={${content}}`);
        continue;
      }
      const it = list[ri++] || {};
      if (!it.role) continue;
      segs.push(`${ro(it.role)}={${String(it.text || '')}}`);
    }
    return segs.join(';');
  };
  const escapeForQuotedArg = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/"/g, '\\"');
  const fallbackTop = `user={{$worldInfo}{$history5}};user={随便输出3段故事，每段分别被[aaa]...[/aaa],[bbb]...[/bbb],[ccc]...[/ccc]包裹}`;
  const topFromTpl = buildTopFromTpl(ns.tpl);
  const finalTop = topFromTpl || fallbackTop;
  // 将任意 UTF-8 字符串转换为 URL-safe base64（用于 top64=），避免逐字节拼接导致的卡顿/卡死
  const b64eUrlSafe = (s) => {
    const input = String(s ?? '');
    try {
      // Desktop (Electron) 环境可能存在 Buffer：速度更快、内存更省
      if (typeof Buffer !== 'undefined' && Buffer?.from) {
        return Buffer.from(input, 'utf-8').toString('base64')
          .replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
      }
    } catch {}

    try {
      if (typeof TextEncoder !== 'undefined') {
        const u8 = new TextEncoder().encode(input);
        const CHUNK = 0x8000;
        const parts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i += CHUNK) {
          parts.push(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, u8.subarray(i, i + CHUNK)));
        }
        return btoa(parts.join('')).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
      }
    } catch {}

    // 兜底方案（无 TextEncoder 的老环境）
    return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(input))).replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
  };
  const stripMarkdown = (input) => {
    let s = String(input || '');
    s = s.replace(/<\/?[^>]+>/g, '');
    s = s.replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, m => m.replace(/^```[^\n]*\n?/, '').replace(/```$/, ''));
    s = s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '$1');
    s = s.replace(/^\s{0,3}#{1,6}\s*/gm, '');
    s = s.replace(/^\s{0,3}>\s?/gm, '');
    s = s.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '$1').replace(/__(.*?)__/g, '$1').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '$1').replace(/_(.*?)_/g, '$1').replace(/~~(.*?)~~/g, '$1');
    s = s.replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1').replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g, '$1');
    s = s.replace(/^(\s{0,3})[-*+]\s+/gm, '$1- ');
    s = s.replace(/^(\s{0,3})(\d+)\.\s+/gm, '$1$2. ');
    s = s.replace(/^\s{0,3}([-*_]){3,}\s*$/gm, '');
    s = s.replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, '\n');
    s = s.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
    return s.trim();
  };
  const decodeEscapedNewlines = (input) => {
    let s = String(input ?? '');
    s = s.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').replace(/\r/g, '\n');
    for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
      s = s.replace(/\\\\r\\\\n/g, '\n').replace(/\\r\\n/g, '\n').replace(/\\\\n/g, '\n').replace(/\\n/g, '\n').replace(/\\\\t/g, '\t').replace(/\\t/g, '\t');
    }
    return s;
  };
  const collapseTripleNewlines = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
  function cleanTextWithConfig(src, cfg = {}) {
    let s = String(src || '');
    const anchors = Array.isArray(cfg.anchors) ? cfg.anchors.filter(Boolean) : [];
    if (anchors.length) {
      const lower = s.toLowerCase();
      let cutPos = -1;
      for (const a of anchors) {
        const needle = String(a || '').toLowerCase();
        if (!needle) continue;
        const pos = lower.indexOf(needle);
        if (pos !== -1) {
          const end = pos + needle.length;
          cutPos = (cutPos === -1) ? end : Math.min(cutPos, end);
        }
      }
      if (cutPos > -1) s = s.slice(cutPos);
    }
    const blocks = Array.isArray(cfg.blockTags) ? cfg.blockTags : [];
    for (const rawTag of blocks) {
      const tag = String(rawTag || '').trim();
      if (!tag) continue;
      const re = new RegExp(`<\\s*${tag}\\b[\\s\\S]*?<\\s*\\/\\s*${tag}\\s*>`, 'ig');
      s = s.replace(re, '');
      const reSelf = new RegExp(`<\\s*${tag}\\b[^>]*\\/\\s*>`, 'ig');
      s = s.replace(reSelf, '');
    }
    if (cfg.stripComments) {
      s = s.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '');
    }
    return s;
  }
  async function resolveHistoryPlaceholder(text) {
    if (!text || typeof text !== 'string') return text;
    const context = window.SillyTavern?.getContext?.();
    const chatArr = Array.isArray(context?.chat) ? context.chat : [];
    if (!chatArr.length) return text;
    const extractText = (msg) => {
      if (typeof msg?.mes === 'string') return msg.mes.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
      if (typeof msg?.content === 'string') return msg.content.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
      if (Array.isArray(msg?.content)) {
        return msg.content.filter(p => p && p.type === 'text' && typeof p.text === 'string').map(p => p.text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')).join('\n');
      }
      return '';
    };
    const historyPlaceholderRegex = /\{\$history(\d{1,3})\}/ig;
    const replaceFn = (match, countStr) => {
      const count = Math.max(1, Math.min(200, Number(countStr)));
      const start = Math.max(0, chatArr.length - count);
      const lines = [];
      for (let i = start; i < chatArr.length; i++) {
        const msg = chatArr[i];
        const isUser = !!msg?.is_user;
        const speaker = isUser
          ? ((msg?.name && String(msg.name).trim()) || (context?.name1 && String(context.name1).trim()) || 'USER')
          : ((msg?.name && String(msg.name).trim()) || (context?.name2 && String(context.name2).trim()) || 'ASSISTANT');
        let textContent = (extractText(msg) || '').trim();
        if (textContent) textContent = cleanTextWithConfig(textContent, ns.clean || {});
        lines.push(`${speaker}：`);
        if (textContent) lines.push(textContent);
        lines.push('');
      }
      let joined = lines.join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
      return joined;
    };
    return text.replace(historyPlaceholderRegex, replaceFn);
  }
  const finalTopProcessed = await resolveHistoryPlaceholder(finalTop);
  const top64 = b64eUrlSafe(finalTopProcessed);
  const apiArgs = [];
  if (provider && provider !== 'st') {
    apiArgs.push(`api=${provider}`);
    if (url) apiArgs.push(`apiurl="${escapeForQuotedArg(url)}"`);
    if (key) apiArgs.push(`apipassword="${escapeForQuotedArg(key)}"`);
    if (mdl) apiArgs.push(`model="${escapeForQuotedArg(mdl)}"`);
    if (enableNet) apiArgs.push(`net=on`);
  } else {
    if (enableNet) apiArgs.push(`net=on`);
  }
  const paramArgs = [];
  const pushNum = (k, v) => { const n = Number(v); if (Number.isFinite(n)) paramArgs.push(`${k}=${n}`); };
  pushNum('temperature', gen.temperature);
  pushNum('top_p', gen.top_p);
  pushNum('top_k', gen.top_k);
  pushNum('presence_penalty', gen.presence_penalty);
  pushNum('frequency_penalty', gen.frequency_penalty);
  const nonstreamPart = useStream ? '' : 'nonstream=true';
  const cmdMain = `/xbgenraw id=${SESSION_ID} ${nonstreamPart} ${paramArgs.join(' ')} ${apiArgs.join(' ')} top64=${top64}`.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

  function waitForStream(sessionId, timeoutMs = 600000) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let done = false;
      const sid = String(sessionId);

      let timer = null;
      let poll = null;
      let onMsg = null;

      const finish = (text) => {
        if (done) return;
        done = true;
        try { if (onMsg) window.removeEventListener('message', onMsg); } catch {}
        try { if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); } catch {}
        try { if (poll) clearInterval(poll); } catch {}
        resolve(String(text || ''));
      };

      onMsg = (evt) => {
        const d = evt?.data;
        if (d?.type !== 'xiaobaix_streaming_completed') return;
        const psid = String(d?.payload?.sessionId ?? '');
        if (psid === sid || psid === `xb${sid}` || `xb${psid}` === sid) {
          finish(String(d?.payload?.finalText || window.xiaobaixStreamingGeneration?.getLastGeneration?.(sessionId) || ''));
        }
      };

      window.addEventListener('message', onMsg);

      // 某些环境 message 事件不会触发，用轮询兜底
      poll = setInterval(() => {
        try {
          const status = window.xiaobaixStreamingGeneration?.getStatus?.(sessionId);
          if (!status) return;
          if (!status.isStreaming) {
            const txt = status.text || window.xiaobaixStreamingGeneration?.getLastGeneration?.(sessionId) || '';
            finish(txt);
          }
        } catch {}
      }, 250);

      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        finish(window.xiaobaixStreamingGeneration?.getLastGeneration?.(sessionId) || '');
      }, timeoutMs);
    });
  }

  const looksLikeSessionId = (v) => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return false;
    const s = String(v).trim();
    if (!s) return false;
    if (s.length > 32) return false;
    if (/\s/.test(s)) return false;
    return /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(s);
  };

  async function runOnce() {
    if (useStream) {
      const startRet = await STscript(cmdMain);

      // 兼容：某些环境/版本在“流式”模式下也会直接返回最终文本
      if (typeof startRet === 'string' && startRet.trim() && !looksLikeSessionId(startRet)) {
        return startRet;
      }

      const sid = looksLikeSessionId(startRet) ? startRet : SESSION_ID;
      const final = await waitForStream(sid);
      return final;
    } else {
      const result = await STscript(cmdMain);
      return String(result || '');
    }
  }
  const attemptOnce = async () => {
    try {
      const rawText = await runOnce();
      const decoded = decodeEscapedNewlines(rawText);
      const plain = stripMarkdown(decoded);
      const allText = collapseTripleNewlines(plain);
      const tagMap = {};
      let m;
      tagRe.lastIndex = 0;
      while ((m = tagRe.exec(allText)) !== null) {
        const tagName = String(m[1] || '').trim();
        const inner = collapseTripleNewlines(stripMarkdown(m[2] || '')).trim();
        if (!tagName || !inner) continue;
        tagMap[tagName] = tagMap[tagName] ? (tagMap[tagName] + '\n' + inner) : inner;
      }
      const ok = allText.trim().length > 0;
      const payloadObj = ok ? { All: allText, ...tagMap } : null;
      return { ok, allText, tagMap, payloadObj, rawText };
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, error: e };
    }
  };
  const MAX_RETRY = 3;
  let lastSuccess = null;
  for (let i = 0; i <= MAX_RETRY; i++) {
    const { ok, payloadObj, allText, tagMap } = await attemptOnce();
    const hasTags = !!tagMap && Object.keys(tagMap).length > 0;
    if (ok && payloadObj && allText?.trim() && hasTags) {
      lastSuccess = payloadObj;
      break;
    }
    if (i < MAX_RETRY) {
      await sleep(700);
    }
  }
  if (!lastSuccess) {
    await STscript(`/echo severity=error 生成失败（已重试${MAX_RETRY}次）。保留原有变量。`);
  } else {
    const esc = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/"/g, '\\"').replace(/\|/g, '｜');
    const cmds = [];
    if (typeof lastSuccess.All === 'string' && lastSuccess.All.trim()) {
      cmds.push(`/setvar key=NY-Sigon index=All "${esc(lastSuccess.All)}"`);
    }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(lastSuccess)) {
      if (k === 'All') continue;
      if (!v || !String(v).trim()) continue;
      cmds.push(`/setvar key=NY-Sigon主程序 index=${k} "${esc(v)}"`);
    }
    if (cmds.length) {
      await STscript(cmds.join(' | '));
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('xb:task:executed', { detail: { name: TASK_NAME, when: Date.now() } }));
    await STscript(`/echo severity=success 输出完成`);
  }
})();
<</taskjs>>

        const gen = readGenFromUI();

    };
    on($('xiaobaix_gen_reset'), 'click', async () => {
      ['xiaobaix_gen_temp','xiaobaix_gen_top_p','xiaobaix_gen_top_k','xiaobaix_gen_pp','xiaobaix_gen_fp'].forEach(id => { const el=$(id); if (el) el.value=''; });
      const gen = {};
      await saveTaskAndTpl({

    on($('xiaobaix_gen_save'), 'click', async () => { await saveTaskConfigFromUI('生成参数已保存'); });
    on($('xiaobaix_save_auto'), 'click', async () => { await saveTaskConfigFromUI('自动分析设置已保存'); });

    on($('xiaobaix_clean_save'), 'click', async () => { await saveTaskConfigFromUI('清洗设置已保存'); });

    on($('xiaobaix_userpref_insert_at'), 'change', () => { userPrefInsertAt = parseInt($('xiaobaix_userpref_insert_at')?.value ?? '', 10); });
    on($('xiaobaix_sum_run'),'click', async()=>{ 
      try{

        }

      }catch(e){ 
        setRunBtnBusy(false);
      }
    });
    on($('xiaobaix_role_add'),'click', ()=>{ (draft.scaffold ||= []).push({ role:'user', text:'' }); renderList(); recalcDirty(); });
    on($('xiaobaix_special_toggle'), 'click', () => {
      if (Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex)) {
        delete draft.specialIndex;
        delete draft.specialRoleType;
        renderList();
      } else {
        draft.specialIndex = (draft.scaffold?.length || 0);
        draft.specialRoleType = draft.specialRoleType || 'system';
        renderList();
      }
      recalcDirty();
    });
    roles?.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const btn = e.target.closest('[data-act]'); if (!btn) return;
      const box = btn.closest('[data-kind]'); if (!box) return;
      const kind = box.dataset.kind, pos = +box.dataset.pos;
      const sc = draft.scaffold ||= []; const hasS = Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex);
      const view = []; for (let i=0,ri=0;i<sc.length+(hasS?1:0);i++){ if(hasS&&i===draft.specialIndex) view.push({kind:'special'}); else view.push({kind:'role',idx:ri++}); }
      const act = btn.dataset.act;
      if (kind==='special') {
        if (!Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex)) return;
        if (act==='up' && draft.specialIndex>0) draft.specialIndex--;
        if (act==='down' && draft.specialIndex<sc.length) draft.specialIndex++;
        renderList(); recalcDirty(); return;
      }
      const ridx = +box.dataset.idx; if (!(ridx>-1) || !sc[ridx]) return;
      if (act==='del'){ if (Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex) && ridx<draft.specialIndex) draft.specialIndex=Math.max(0,draft.specialIndex-1); sc.splice(ridx,1); if (Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex)) draft.specialIndex=Math.min(draft.specialIndex, sc.length); renderList(); recalcDirty(); return; }
      if (act==='up'){ const prev=view[pos-1]; if (!prev) return; if (prev.kind==='special'){ if (Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex)) draft.specialIndex=Math.min(sc.length, draft.specialIndex+1); } else { const a=ridx,b=prev.idx; [sc[a],sc[b]]=[sc[b],sc[a]]; } renderList(); recalcDirty(); return; }
      if (act==='down'){ const next=view[pos+1]; if (!next) return; if (next.kind==='special'){ if (Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex)) draft.specialIndex=Math.max(0, draft.specialIndex-1); } else { const a=ridx,b=next.idx; [sc[a],sc[b]]=[sc[b],sc[a]]; } renderList(); recalcDirty(); return; }
    });
    roles?.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
      const sel = e.target.closest('select'); if (!sel) return;
      const wrap = sel.closest('[data-kind]'); if (!wrap) return;
      if (wrap.dataset.kind==='special' && sel.matches('[data-role="special-select"]')) { draft.specialRoleType = sel.value; return; }
      if (wrap.dataset.kind==='role' && sel.matches('[data-role="select"]')) {
        const ridx = +wrap.dataset.idx; (draft.scaffold ||= []); draft.scaffold[ridx] ||= { role:'', text:'' }; draft.scaffold[ridx].role = sel.value;
      }
    });
    roles?.addEventListener('input', (e)=>{
      const ta = e.target.closest('textarea[data-role="text"]'); if (!ta) return;
      const wrap = ta.closest('[data-kind="role"]'); if (!wrap) return;
      const ridx = +wrap.dataset.idx; (draft.scaffold ||= []); draft.scaffold[ridx] ||= { role:'user', text:'' }; draft.scaffold[ridx].text = ta.value;
    });
    on($('xiaobaix_sum_hist'), 'input', () => {
      const val = $('xiaobaix_sum_hist')?.value ?? '';
      const hasVal = String(val).trim() !== '' && Number.isFinite(+val);
      if (hasVal && !Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex)) {
        draft.specialIndex = (draft.scaffold?.length || 0);
        draft.specialRoleType = draft.specialRoleType || 'system';
        renderList();
      }
    });
    on($('xiaobaix_sum_wi'), 'input', () => {
      const checked = !!$('xiaobaix_sum_wi')?.checked;
      if (checked && !Number.isInteger(draft.specialIndex)) {
        draft.specialIndex = (draft.scaffold?.length || 0);
        draft.specialRoleType = draft.specialRoleType || 'system';
        renderList();
      }
    });
    on($('xiaobaix_sum_save_tpl'),'click', async ()=>{
      await saveTaskConfigFromUI('保存完成');
    });
    const providerSel = $('xiaobaix_api_provider');
    const urlInput = $('xiaobaix_api_url');
    const keyInput = $('xiaobaix_api_key');
    const connectBtn = $('xiaobaix_api_connect');
    const modelSelect = $('xiaobaix_api_model_select');
    const modelSelectWrap = $('xiaobaix_api_model_select_wrap');
    const modelText = $('xiaobaix_api_model_text');
    const modelTextWrap = $('xiaobaix_api_model_text_wrap');
    const netCk = $('xiaobaix_api_net');
    const streamCk = $('xiaobaix_api_stream');
    const urlWrap = $('xiaobaix_api_url_wrap');
    const keyWrap = $('xiaobaix_api_key_wrap');
    function applySavedModelToSelect() {
      const cfg2 = loadCfg();
      const saved = String((cfg2?.api?.model)||'').trim() || String(loadApiCfg().model||'').trim();
      if (!modelSelect) return;
      if (!modelSelect.options) return;
      if (saved) {
        let has = false;
        for (const opt of Array.from(modelSelect.options)) { if (opt.value === saved) { has = true; break; } }
        if (!has) {
          const opt = document.createElement('option');
          opt.value = saved; opt.textContent = saved + ' •saved';
          modelSelect.appendChild(opt);
        }
        modelSelect.value = saved;
        if (modelText) modelText.value = saved;
      }
    }
    const setProviderUiState = (pv) => {
      const usingST = pv === 'st';
      const isOpenAI = pv === 'openai';
      urlWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', usingST);
      keyWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', usingST);
      connectBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', !isOpenAI);
      const apiCfgNow = loadApiCfg();
      const hasCache = Array.isArray(apiCfgNow.cache) && apiCfgNow.cache.length > 0;
      modelSelectWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', !isOpenAI || !hasCache);
      modelSelect.classList.toggle('hidden', !isOpenAI || !hasCache);
      modelTextWrap.classList.toggle('hidden', usingST || (isOpenAI && hasCache));
      if (isOpenAI && hasCache) applySavedModelToSelect();
    };
    const apiCfgInit = loadApiCfg();
    providerSel.value = apiCfgInit.provider || 'st';
    urlInput.value = apiCfgInit.url || '';
    keyInput.value = apiCfgInit.key || '';
    modelText.value = apiCfgInit.model || '';
    netCk.checked = !!apiCfgInit.enableNet;
    streamCk.checked = apiCfgInit.stream ?? true;
    if (Array.isArray(apiCfgInit.cache) && apiCfgInit.cache.length > 0) {
      modelSelect.innerHTML = apiCfgInit.cache.map(id => `<option value="${h(id)}">${h(id)}</option>`).join('');
      applySavedModelToSelect();
    } else {
      modelSelect.innerHTML = '';
    }
    setProviderUiState(providerSel.value);
    const getApiModelFromUI = () => {
      const usingSelect = !modelSelectWrap?.classList.contains('hidden') && !modelSelect?.classList.contains('hidden');
      const fromSelect = usingSelect ? String(modelSelect?.value || '').trim() : '';
      const fromText = String(modelText?.value || '').trim();
      return fromSelect || fromText;
    };
    const persistOnChange = () => {
      saveApiCfg({ provider: providerSel.value || 'st', url: urlInput.value.trim(), key: keyInput.value.trim(), model: getApiModelFromUI(), enableNet: !!netCk.checked, stream: !!streamCk.checked });
    };
    on(providerSel, 'change', () => { setProviderUiState(providerSel.value); persistOnChange(); streamEnabled = !!streamCk.checked; });
    on(urlInput, 'input', persistOnChange);
    on(keyInput, 'input', persistOnChange);
    on(modelText, 'input', persistOnChange);
    on(netCk, 'input', persistOnChange);
    on(streamCk, 'input', () => { persistOnChange(); streamEnabled = !!streamCk.checked; });
    on(modelSelect, 'change', async () => {
      const chosen = modelSelect.value || '';
      if (chosen) {
        if (modelText) modelText.value = chosen;
        await saveApiCfg({ model: chosen });
        toastr?.success?.('已选择模型');
      }
    });
    on($('xiaobaix_api_save'), 'click', async () => {
      const ok = await saveTaskConfigFromUI('');
      if (!ok) return;
      try {
        await saveApiCfg({
          provider: providerSel.value || 'st',
          url: urlInput.value.trim(),
          key: keyInput.value.trim(),
          model: getApiModelFromUI(),
          enableNet: !!netCk.checked,
          stream: !!streamCk.checked
        });
        toastr?.success?.('API 设置已保存');
      } catch (e) {
        toastr?.error?.(e?.message || '保存失败');
      }
    });
    const fetchOpenAIModels = async (baseUrl, apiKey) => {
        const normalize = (url) => String(url || '').replace(/\/+$/,'');
        let url = normalize(baseUrl) + '/v1/models';
        try {
            const res = await fetch(url, { 
                headers: { 
                    'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 
                    'Accept':'application/json' 
                } 
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                const data = await res.json();
                const items = Array.isArray(data?.data) ? data.data.map(m => m?.id).filter(Boolean) : [];
                return [...new Set(items)];
            }
        } catch {}
        if (baseUrl.includes('/v1')) {
            const stripped = normalize(baseUrl.replace(/\/v1\/?$/, ''));
            url = stripped + '/v1/models';
            try {
                const res = await fetch(url, { 
                    headers: { 
                        'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 
                        'Accept':'application/json' 
                    } 
                });
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    const items = Array.isArray(data?.data) ? data.data.map(m => m?.id).filter(Boolean) : [];
                    return [...new Set(items)];
                }
            } catch {}
        }
        throw new Error('连接失败,请检查 URL 和 KEY');
    };
    on(connectBtn, 'click', async () => {
        try {
            if (providerSel.value !== 'openai') { 
                toastr?.info?.('当前仅支持 OpenAI 兼容拉取模型'); 
                return; 
            }
            const base = urlInput.value.trim() || 'https://api.openai.com';
            const key = keyInput.value.trim();
            if (!key) { 
                toastr?.warning?.('请先填写 KEY'); 
                return; 
            }
            connectBtn.disabled = true; 
            connectBtn.textContent = '连接中...';
            const models = await fetchOpenAIModels(base, key);
            if (!models.length) { 
                toastr?.warning?.('未获取到模型'); 
                return; 
            }
            modelSelect.innerHTML = models.map(id => `<option value="${h(id)}">${h(id)}</option>`).join('');
            await saveApiCfg({ cache: models });
            applySavedModelToSelect();
            if (!modelSelect.value && modelSelect.options.length) {
                modelSelect.value = modelSelect.options[0].value;
                await saveApiCfg({ model: modelSelect.value });
            }
            modelSelectWrap.classList.remove('hidden');
            modelSelect.classList.remove('hidden');
            toastr?.success?.(`获取成功：${models.length} 个模型`);
        } catch (e) {
            toastr?.error?.(e.message || '连接失败');
        } finally {
            connectBtn.disabled = false; 
            connectBtn.textContent = '连接/拉取模型';
        }
    });

    const updateTitleAnim = () => {
      const chk = $('xiaobaix_sum_enabled');
      const title = $('ny_title_text');
      const txt = $('xiaobaix_sum_enabled_text');
      if (chk) {
        if (chk.checked) {
          if (title) title.classList.add('ny-monitor-active');
          if (txt) txt.textContent = '运行中';
        } else {
          if (title) title.classList.remove('ny-monitor-active');
          if (txt) txt.textContent = '未启动';
        }
      }
    };
    on($('xiaobaix_sum_enabled'), 'change', updateTitleAnim);
    
    // 初始化折叠事件
    const setupCollapsibles = () => {
      const headers = root.querySelectorAll('.box-header');

        h.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
           if (e.target.closest('button') || e.target.closest('input') || e.target.closest('select')) return;
           const box = h.closest('.box');
           if (box) box.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        });
      });
    };
    setupCollapsibles();

    updateTitleAnim();
  };
  await openUI();
})();
